caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot positioned in the center of the composition. The teapot features a rounded, bulbous body that gradually narrows toward the top, where it meets a domed, decorative lid with a small finial at its peak. The spout of the teapot curves outward and upward from the left side and ends in a slightly flared tip. The handle, attached on the right side, is large, curved, and appears to be made of a different, darker material than the main body of the teapot. Shading is used throughout the drawing to give the metallic surface of the teapot a reflective appearance, and there are several areas of lighter highlights suggesting the shininess of the object. The overall color scheme is grayscale, with the background left as plain, unshaded paper. The artist's name and the year "1937" are written in small letters at the bottom left corner.
title: Silver Teapot
